cuts.scene: Lanterns reflect across a canal at blue hour; she carries a small paper tray with one berry pastry.
cuts.outfit: A lilac off-shoulder blouse tucked into a high-slit green wrap skirt leaves her shoulders and one thigh visible, with a petal-shaped clasp at the waist.

cuts.scene: She glides through a broad turn on a riverside skating path in clear morning sunlight, arms balancing her movement.
cuts.outfit: A leaf-green racerback knit top cropped at the waist and high-rise purple running shorts bare her shoulders, midriff and legs, paired with pink quad skates and wrist guards.

cuts.scene: In a theatre dressing alcove before a masked ball, she finishes tying the ribbon of a feathered eye mask held beside her face.
cuts.outfit: A plum satin dress has a structured strapless bodice, a full skirt parted by a deep side slit and gold feather embroidery.

cuts.scene: At a breakfast nook she stirs honey into a bowl of yogurt while the first daylight reaches the table.
cuts.outfit: A mauve ribbed knit-blend lingerie set has a relaxed cropped top, wide secure straps and matching opaque high-waisted bottoms, exposing her shoulders, midriff and upper thighs.

cuts.scene: In a vinyl record store she lifts a record sleeve from a low crate, inspecting the abstract sea-wave artwork.
cuts.outfit: Sea-pink short overalls with low sides over a yellow bikini top expose her shoulders, sides and legs; canvas sneakers and a compact satchel complete the look.

cuts.scene: She steps up a resort pool staircase after a lap, right hand resting on the metal rail as droplets fall into turquoise water.
cuts.outfit: A fully lined mauve wrap-front swimsuit has a crossed bodice, a secure waist tie and high-cut legs, with a fine pale-yellow edge.
